glosses: To become loose.

examples.text: Max caught Bigger’s shoulders in a tight grip; then his fingers loosened and he sank back to the cot […]

glosses: To disengage (a device that restrains).

examples.text:
At Liberty th’ unfetter’d Captive stands,
And flings the loosen’d Shackles from his Hands.

glosses: To become unfastened or undone.

examples.text: Immediately my Shackles loosened and fell away of themselves […]

glosses: To free from restraint; to set at liberty.

examples.text: This is an admirable Rule; a Painter ought to have it perpetually present in his Mind and Memory. […] it loosens his hands, and assists his understanding.

examples.text:
